purpose: Error-driven improvement of best CatBoost200; no new neural models

cycles.hypothesis: Frequent false positives reflect missing per-program completion and duration calibration
cycles.change: Add historical program completion, duration, consumption and channel-normalized propensity features

cycles.hypothesis: New-to-user targets are retrieved but poorly ranked; existing start-hour aggregate ignores weekly schedule and completion likelihood
cycles.change: Add raw-view channel-time occupancy matched to future airing slots; history only before cutoff

cycles.hypothesis: Five-week targets differ from twelve-week competition horizon
cycles.change: Train on longer historical horizons and check ten-week validation

selection: Earlier window selects; later and longer reused validation windows confirm. Submit locally improved candidates only; do not tune directly on private outcomes. Repeated Kaggle evaluation is adaptive, not independent test.
additional_cycles: Repeat forecast conditioned on SAME channel
Novelty and popularity logit calibration (15 settings)
Hard-negative top30 reranking; ungated failure retained, fixed top30 gate
technical_notes: An initial normalization of 4.994-week DST training exposure changed the baseline slightly; stage0 records this control. Stages13-15 preserve original training scale exactly and normalize only long/final horizons.

Hard-negative classifier without gate generalized catastrophically to easy candidates absent from its negative training pool. Corrected to rerank only first-stage Top30; raw ungated scores retained as failed experiment.
Every candidate remains restricted to future schedule IDs; all feature numerators are past user behavior.

Historical wide-window analysis generated by the reused helper labels HGB evaluation as validation; it is partially in-sample and is not used for model selection. New models are evaluated only on dev/audit/long.
Calibration adds fewer new-to-user programs, contrary to initial hypothesis; later five-week improves marginally but long declines. No significance claim.

Initial rank-position diagnostics omitted the cold-user fallback and popularity tie breaker. Recomputed exact production rankings and asserted every Top5 agrees. This changes some cohort hit counts, not model scores or any selection metric.
Nearest-neighbor helper now supports catalogs with fewer users than requested k (tested on two synthetic users); no change for actual 4914-user data.
